close_reason: 8 KiB stack buffer replaced with encode_to_vec() heap path; Error::Der doc updated; test added
description: validate_path re-encodes each TBSCertificate into a fixed 8 KiB stack buffer for signature verification. Certificates whose TBSCertificate DER encoding exceeds 8 KiB return Error::Der. Large government, enterprise, or HSM attestation certificates may trigger this. A heap-backed encoding path is needed for v0.2.
title: pkix-path: 8 KiB TBSCertificate stack buffer hard limit
